summary: No installer-harm evidence observed in permcserver@1.0.2
details: No a static rule matches and no traced behavioral findings were produced for this package version. With only two files in scope and no evidence of exfiltration, install-time fetch-and-execute, silent relay, credential distribution, backdoor, or destructive install/import-time actions, there is no basis to classify this as a supply-chain attack against installers.
